summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of ExamAce (FastAPI + React + MongoDB + AI) completed. 22/22 backend pytest cases passed (auth, questions, daily, attempts, AI explain/similar, mock-test full flow, results, performance, doubt, admin CRUD, role enforcement). Frontend Playwright tests covered landing, login (demo/admin), signup, dashboard, practice (answer + AI explain + generate similar), exams listing, full mock test lifecycle (timer/palette/submit/result), analytics, doubt chat, admin users/questions/tests, and student blocked from /admin. All critical flows pass.

issues: AI answer is rendered as raw Markdown + LaTeX (e.g. '\[ ... \]', '####', '**bold**'); no markdown/KaTeX renderer is applied, making answers hard to read.
Initial mock-tests list render shows a loading spinner briefly with no visible skeleton; navigating from other pages occasionally required ~3s for API to return (intermittent, not a bug).

action_items: Consider rendering Markdown (and optionally LaTeX via KaTeX/MathJax) for Doubt chat answers and AI explanation text; currently raw markdown tokens are visible.
Optional: add a skeleton loader on Exams page while GET /api/mock-tests is in-flight to mask the brief spinner.
Optional: pydantic v2 validators for sub.answers values (currently selected_index is cast from str via int()).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700 lines (732) — consider splitting into routers per resource (auth/questions/mock/admin/doubt).

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True — browsers reject '*' with credentials; since app uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) this is fine today, but set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in prod.
GET /questions/{id}/explain caches ai_explanation on the question doc permanently — good for cost; but a stale/incorrect LLM answer will persist forever with no invalidation endpoint.
POST /mock-tests/{id}/submit uses int(sel) on user-supplied answers without try/except — malformed values would 500 (Pydantic dict type not validated).
No rate limiting on AI endpoints (explain / similar / doubt / feedback) — abuse risk.
Doubt chat renders raw markdown/LaTeX; integrate react-markdown + rehype-katex.
All MongoDB operations correctly exclude _id via projection — good.
seed_data_creation: Used startup-seeded data: 30 questions, 3 mock tests, admin + student accounts. Also created transient TEST_ prefixed question/mock-test which were cleaned up by CRUD tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, hits REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). AI endpoints (explain/similar/feedback/doubt) take 2-15s; tests use 60s timeouts. /api/mock-tests/{id}/submit expects {answers: {question_id: selected_index}, time_taken_seconds}. Session token key is 'examace_token' in localStorage. MockTest route /test/:id has no Navbar (full-screen).
